+            ):
+                existing_flows = existing_definition.get("flows", {})
+                new_flows = security_definition.get("flows", {})
+                for flow_type, flow_data in new_flows.items():
+                    if flow_type in existing_flows:
+                        existing_scopes = existing_flows[flow_type].get("scopes", {})
+                        new_scopes = flow_data.get("scopes", {})
+                        existing_flows[flow_type]["scopes"] = {**existing_scopes, **new_scopes}
+                    else:
+                        existing_flows[flow_type] = flow_data
+            else:
+                security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
+        else:
+            security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
+        print(f"DEBUG: security_name={security_name}, security_definitions={security_definitions}")
         operation_security.append({security_name: security_requirement.scopes})

diff --git a/repro.py b/repro.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..9a1041e4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/repro.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+import json
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+auth1 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"read": "Read access"})
+auth2 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="token", scopes={"write": "Write access"})
+
+@app.get("/read")
+def read(token: str = Security(auth1, scopes=["read"])):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+@app.get("/write")
+def write(token: str = Security(auth2, scopes=["write"])):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+openapi_schema = get_openapi(title="Test App", version="1.0.0", routes=app.routes)
+security_schemes = openapi_schema.get("components", {}).get("securitySchemes", {})
+oauth2_scheme = security_schemes.get("OAuth2PasswordBearer", {})
+password_flow = oauth2_scheme.get("flows", {}).get("password", {})
+scopes = password_flow.get("scopes", {})
+
+print(f"Scopes: {scopes}")
+expected_scopes = {"read": "Read access", "write": "Write access"}
+if scopes == expected_scopes:
+    print("SUCCESS: All scopes are present")
+else:
+    print(f"FAILURE: Expected {expected_scopes}, got {scopes}")
+
+# Also check if the operations have the correct security requirements
+for path, methods in openapi_schema.get("paths", {}).items():
+    for method, op in methods.items():
+        security = op.get("security", [])
+        print(f"Path {path} {method} security: {security}")
